pr-me-rank.label: Punjab Kings' place in the power ranking
pr-me-rank.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
pr-me-rank.query: SELECT i.batting_team_id bt, i.bowling_team_id wt, SUM(d.total_runs) runs, SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2025 AND 2026 GROUP BY bt, wt

pr-net.label: Punjab Kings' net run rate (runs per over scored minus conceded)
pr-net.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
pr-net.query: SELECT i.batting_team_id bt, i.bowling_team_id wt, SUM(d.total_runs) runs, SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2025 AND 2026 GROUP BY bt, wt

validation.method: plausibility range -3–3 for net run rate

pr-win.label: Punjab Kings' win rate
pr-win.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
pr-win.query: WITH ms AS (SELECT m.match_id, CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, replace(m.date, '/', '-') dt, m.venue_id, v.city, m.team1_id t1, m.team2_id t2, m.winner_id w FROM matches m LEFT JOIN venues v ON v.venue_id = m.venue_id), inn AS (SELECT i.match_id, MAX(CASE WHEN i.innings_number = 1 THEN i.batting_team_id END) bat1, MAX(CASE WHEN i.innings_number = 1 THEN i.runs END) r1, MAX(CASE WHEN i.innings_number = 2 THEN i.runs END) r2, MAX(CASE WHEN i.innings_number = 2 THEN i.total_legal_balls END) b2, MAX(CASE WHEN i.innings_number > 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) so FROM innings i GROUP BY i.match_id), dl AS (SELECT d.match_id, SUM(CASE WHEN d.batter_runs = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) sixes, SUM(d.total_runs) runs FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 GROUP BY d.match_id) SELECT ms.*, CAST(strftime('%w', ms.dt) AS INTEGER) wd, inn.bat1, inn.r1, inn.r2, inn.b2, inn.so, COALESCE(dl.sixes, 0) sixes, COALESCE(dl.runs, 0) runs FROM ms JOIN inn ON inn.match_id = ms.match_id LEFT JOIN dl ON dl.match_id = ms.match_id ORDER BY ms.dt

pr-rank.label: CricField power ranking, 2025–2026
pr-rank.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
pr-rank.filters: Score = average of standardised net run rate and standardised win rate
pr-rank.query: SELECT i.batting_team_id bt, i.bowling_team_id wt, SUM(d.total_runs) runs, SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2025 AND 2026 GROUP BY bt, wt ;; WITH ms AS (SELECT m.match_id, CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, replace(m.date, '/', '-') dt, m.venue_id, v.city, m.team1_id t1, m.team2_id t2, m.winner_id w FROM matches m LEFT JOIN venues v ON v.venue_id = m.venue_id), inn AS (SELECT i.match_id, MAX(CASE WHEN i.innings_number = 1 THEN i.batting_team_id END) bat1, MAX(CASE WHEN i.innings_number = 1 THEN i.runs END) r1, MAX(CASE WHEN i.innings_number = 2 THEN i.runs END) r2, MAX(CASE WHEN i.innings_number = 2 THEN i.total_legal_balls END) b2, MAX(CASE WHEN i.innings_number > 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) so FROM innings i GROUP BY i.match_id), dl AS (SELECT d.match_id, SUM(CASE WHEN d.batter_runs = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) sixes, SUM(d.total_runs) runs FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 GROUP BY d.match_id) SELECT ms.*, CAST(strftime('%w', ms.dt) AS INTEGER) wd, inn.bat1, inn.r1, inn.r2, inn.b2, inn.so, COALESCE(dl.sixes, 0) sixes, COALESCE(dl.runs, 0) runs FROM ms JOIN inn ON inn.match_id = ms.match_id LEFT JOIN dl ON dl.match_id = ms.match_id ORDER BY ms.dt
